verses.t: “Suṇātha ñātayo sabbe, yāvantettha samāgatā; Dhammaṁ vo desayissāmi, dukkhā jāti punappunaṁ.
Ārambhatha nikkamatha, Yuñjatha buddhasāsane; Dhunātha maccuno senaṁ, Naḷāgāraṁva kuñjaro.
Yo imasmiṁ dhammavinaye, appamatto vihassati; Pahāya jātisaṁsāraṁ, dukkhassantaṁ karissatī”ti. … Abhibhūto thero ….
